earlier_attempts: Blender Python module crashed; used installed Blender 4.5.3 executable.
Blender property/root handling errors and UE import-data compile errors repaired; logs retained.
Texture gamma mutation during asynchronous compilation asserted; wait before PreEditChange fixed it.

Initial anatomy/color passed old tests but was visually rejected: white pigments, floating fur, overly regular normals. Linear FBX colors, intact generated pigment atlas, fused rat anatomy and weak normals replaced them.

Generic FReimportManager silently selected Interchange, mixing bind conversion with legacy animation imports and visibly twisting creatures. Those new packages were archived; all 11 bodies and 10 clips were freshly imported together through legacy FBX. Existing immutable packages now skip reimport.
First upright assertion wrongly rejected harmless yaw; revised to compare vertical direction and body height. Final upDot is 1.0 for both live creatures.
